name: Farren's Proof
summary: Farren's Proof is an Alliance courier mission within the harbor town of Southshore. Acting on behalf of Marshal Redpath, an adventurer delivers orders directing Lieutenant Farren Orinelle to focus his military attention on the naga encroaching upon the Eastern Strand.

sections.title: A Shift in Command
sections.body: Southshore's military leadership is hard-pressed by surrounding threats, yet Marshal Redpath remains attentive to maritime dangers along the southern coast. Having received fresh intelligence concerning naga incursions upon the Eastern Strand, Redpath dispatches a runner across town to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle with direct orders: abandon peripheral distractions, eliminate the amphibious menace, and deliver his progress reports directly to the Marshal in person.

sections.title: Rivalry on the Coast
sections.body: Upon receiving the message, Lieutenant Orinelle reveals the quiet friction festering among Southshore's garrison officers. Rather than offering dutiful compliance, Orinelle suspects Redpath is capitalizing on recently shared intelligence to claim credit for pacifying the shoreline. Determined not to let his commanding officer reap a promotion off his soldiers' sweat, Orinelle immediately begins scheming his own avenue to curry favor with the crown.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this delivery?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath intends to redirect Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's troops toward the naga infesting Hillsbrad's Eastern Strand, requiring Orinelle to report back to him directly once measurable progress is made.

faq.q: Why does Farren Orinelle react bitterly to Redpath's orders?
faq.answer: Orinelle believes Redpath is acting on identical military intelligence they both just received. He fears the Marshal intends to take credit for clearing the coast and earn a promotion off Orinelle's hard labor.

faq.q: Where is the Eastern Strand located?
faq.answer: The Eastern Strand stretches along the southern saltwater coastline of the Hillsbrad Foothills, situated southeast of Southshore where encroaching naga have established foul encampments on the sand.

faq.q: What comes next after delivering this message?
faq.answer: Following this encounter, Orinelle hatches his own scheme rather than submitting cleanly to Redpath's authority, pointing adventurous couriers down the coast and toward high command in the quest 'Stormwind Ho!'.

faq.q: Who are the leaders involved in this exchange?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath serves as Southshore's primary garrison commander, while Lieutenant Farren Orinelle serves under him as a field lieutenant overseeing coastal defense efforts.

faq.q: Does this assignment require any combat?
faq.answer: No. This specific step is purely an internal communication errand between officers within Southshore, though it deals directly with the military response to naga hostiles along the shore.

angles.text: The exchange offers a glimpse into the bureaucratic and career rivalries simmering inside Southshore's garrison, showing that even in besieged northern outposts, officers jockey for prestige.
Navigating the petty jealousies of officer politics is a familiar frustration for soldiers serving the Alliance banner, where battlefield prowess often clashes with command ambition.
